items.agency: City of Albuquerque and Bernalillo County
items.title: Los Duranes Sector Development Plan — Draft Vision and Goals (September 2009)
items.description: Sets out the community draft vision and goals for family heritage, land and water, agriculture, housing, mobility, and neighborhood character during preparation of the Los Duranes Sector Development Plan.
items.provenance_status: official City Council document collection and direct original PDF reviewed
processing_notes: Retained as a substantive September 2009 workshop-draft planning record distinct from the later adopted transportation section.
Original official PDF preserved without modification; its direct City source and City Council collection page were reviewed.

items.agency: City of Albuquerque and Bernalillo County
items.title: Los Duranes Sector Development Plan — Neighborhood Review Draft (May 2010)
items.description: Presents the complete neighborhood-review draft of the Los Duranes Sector Development Plan, including conditions, vision, land use, transportation, acequias, design standards, implementation, and proposed zoning before 2012 adoption.
items.provenance_status: official City Council document collection and direct original PDF reviewed
processing_notes: Retained as the complete May 2010 neighborhood-review draft, historically distinct from the adopted 2012 transportation-section record.
Original official PDF preserved without modification; its direct City source and City Council collection page were reviewed.
